description: This file contains utility functions for color manipulation and comparison, including blending, color space conversions, and color difference calculations based on CIE94.

methods.name: blendWithWhite
methods.description: Blends a color component with white based on alpha transparency.

methods.name: rgb2gray
methods.description: Converts RGB color to grayscale using an integer formula.

methods.name: colorDeltaE94
methods.description: Calculates perceived color difference between two RGB colors using CIE94.

methods.name: srgb2xyz
methods.description: Converts sRGB color to normalized XYZ color space.

methods.name: xyz2lab
methods.description: Converts XYZ color to CIELAB color space.
